stories.title: Energy Lifeline or Putin Payday? Trump's Russian Diesel Deal Splits Washington
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Delivers: President Strikes Deal to Flood U.S. With Cheap Diesel, Crushing Prices at the Pump
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Hands Putin a Sanctions Lifeline to Buy Lower Gas Prices Before the Midterms
stories.poll_question: Was the Russia diesel deal the right call?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Lower fuel costs for families beat symbolic pressure on Moscow.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Rewarding Russia with sanctions relief for a pre-election price stunt.

stories.title: Self-Defense or Street Execution? ICE Shooting of Bronx Father Ignites New York
stories.conservative_headline: Obama Judge Blocks Removal of Criminal Illegal Alien Shot While Endangering ICE Officers
stories.liberal_headline: ICE Agent Shoots Father in the Neck With His 5-Year-Old in the Car as Protests Erupt
stories.poll_question: Who's at fault in the Bronx ICE shooting?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Officers faced a dangerous suspect with a violent criminal record.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Shooting a father beside his child is never acceptable enforcement.

stories.title: Hiring Freeze or Trump Slump? 29,000 Jobs and Rising Prices Before the Vote
stories.conservative_headline: Unemployment Still Historically Low as Trump Economy Absorbs Fed Rate Hikes
stories.liberal_headline: Economy Stalls: Just 29,000 Jobs Added as Wage Growth Hits 5-Year Low and Prices Climb
stories.poll_question: How healthy is the economy right now?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Low unemployment and growth continue despite Fed tightening and global shocks.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Hiring collapsed, revisions turned negative, and inflation is eating paychecks.

stories.title: Accountability or Intimidation? Trump Launches Committee to Probe Fed's Lisa Cook
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Orders Investigation Into Fed Governor Cook as Questions Mount Over Her Conduct
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Escalates War on the Fed With Investigative Committee Targeting Lisa Cook
stories.poll_question: Is investigating Fed Governor Cook legitimate?
stories.poll_option1_desc: No official, including Fed governors, should be above investigation.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Pressuring the Fed to bend rates destroys central bank independence.

stories.title: Strategic Patience or Election Timing? Trump Says No Iran Strike Before Midterms
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Keeps Iran Guessing: No Strike for Now as Maximum Pressure Squeezes Tehran
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Admits War Timing Is About Elections, Announcing Iran Strikes Will Wait Until After Nov. 3
stories.poll_question: Should Iran policy be tied to the election calendar?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Strategic ambiguity and restraint protect troops and strengthen negotiating position.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Scheduling military action around votes puts politics above national security.

stories.title: Transparency or Spectacle? Livestreaming the Fort Hood Shooter's Execution
stories.conservative_headline: Justice in the Open: Pentagon Says Americans Deserve to See the Fort Hood Terrorist Face Justice
stories.liberal_headline: Vance Breaks With Hegseth as Pentagon's Plan to Livestream a Firing Squad Draws Legal Alarm
stories.poll_option1_desc: Victims and the public deserve full transparency in capital punishment.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Broadcasting a killing degrades justice and turns death into entertainment.

stories.title: Judicial Overreach or Constitutional Check? SCOTUS Weighs Climate Suits Against Big Oil
stories.conservative_headline: Activist Cities Try to Set National Energy Policy Through Courtrooms, Justices Told
stories.liberal_headline: Supreme Court Could Slam the Courthouse Door on Communities Suing Big Oil for Climate Damage
stories.poll_question: Should cities be able to sue oil companies over climate change?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Energy policy belongs to Congress, not local juries and trial lawyers.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Communities harmed by deception deserve their day in court.

stories.title: Press Accountability or Payback? White House Boots Politico From Trump's Travel Pool
stories.conservative_headline: White House Decides Who Gets Access, Sidelines Partisan Outlets Posing as Reporters
stories.liberal_headline: Retaliation Watch: White House Strips Politico From Press Pool as Judge Questions Media Bans
stories.poll_question: Can the White House pick which outlets cover the president?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Access is a privilege; no outlet has a constitutional right to it.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Punishing critical coverage is textbook government retaliation against a free press.

stories.title: Hiring Reform or Lowered Bar? Durbin Demands Probe of FBI's New Standards
stories.conservative_headline: Democrats Attack FBI for Modernizing Outdated Hiring Rules That Shrank the Applicant Pool
stories.liberal_headline: FBI Quietly Drops Theft and Bestiality From Automatic Disqualifiers; Durbin Demands Investigation
stories.poll_question: Were the FBI's relaxed hiring rules appropriate?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Case-by-case review beats rigid blanket bans on qualified applicants.
stories.poll_option2_desc: The nation's top law enforcement agency should not lower its integrity bar.

stories.title: Protecting Workers or Choking Talent? U.S. Suspends Microsoft and Adobe From Green Card Program
stories.conservative_headline: America First Wins: Administration Suspends Big Tech Giants From Foreign Labor Pipeline
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Targets Microsoft and Adobe in Immigration Crackdown Economists Say Will Backfire on Innovation
stories.poll_question: Was suspending big tech from the green card program right?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Companies laying off Americans shouldn't get cheaper foreign labor pipelines.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Blocking skilled immigrants hands global tech leadership to competitors.
